long_biography.plain_text:
Oil and commodities trading defined Alexey Kuzmichev's early work in Alfa Group. He met future partners Mikhail Fridman and German Khan at the Moscow Institute of Steel and Alloys, then joined the Alfa-Eco trading venture. He directed international sales and later worked through Crown Resources, the group's oil-trading arm. The partners' interest in TNK-BP became a major source of capital when the oil venture was sold.

Alfa's expansion also placed Kuzmichev in the governance of a wider investment group. He was among the founders and directors of LetterOne, formed after the TNK-BP exit to invest across industries. Its audit and compliance committee included him during his board tenure. He left all LetterOne positions in 2022 as the company's governance changed.
